verdict.rationale: Government digital services can plausibly publish their source code under an open license, so this axis applies to TWC's online services such as UTR, UTS and QuickFile. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a source repository, an open-source license or public code. The probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI concern machine-readable docs and APIs, not source openness, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
